release_notes: v9.8.30 — Voucher-date window scoping for incremental syncs (only pulls vouchers within an explicit date range instead of always full-history), plus carry-forward of iter-107 fixes: raw parentheses/apostrophes/quotes in SVCURRENTCOMPANY (only the three XML-mandated entities are escaped now — & < > — because Tally's TDL matcher does NOT decode numeric character refs or '/" back to literals). Faster startup on Tally Prime 7.0, less network chatter, no more false 'company not loaded' errors after upgrade. Customer-side: run the new .exe from the same folder, choose Replace when Windows prompts.
